notes: `כְּ` takes the correlative pair *as ... so* as one discontinuous unit (rules 14, 25); the ASV splits one Hebrew verbless clause into two English ones, so each written copula joins the nominal of the clause it stands in under rule 20.
*their camels' necks* is the possessive rendering of rule 29: the determiner is the suffix's, the construct keeping only its own word.
